topic: Custom tool integrations using model context protocols

components.title: Static analysis and linter rules for safe MCP server code
components.teaches: Students will configure static analysis tools to validate type safety, async patterns, and error handling in custom MCP server implementations. They will identify common static analyser warnings related to untyped JSON schema bindings and unhandled promises.

components.title: Activity: Passing automated MCP tool test suites without warnings
components.teaches: Students will run integration test suites against their configured MCP tool integration in an agent workspace environment. They will fix failing test cases and resolve all static analysis warnings to ensure production-grade tool configuration.
